params.body:
## Why

A trend reaches gentells.com only when at least five of the signals that support it were seen on a platform (#451). Europe hardly has those:
- TikTok Creative Center no longer publishes trends for Belgium or the Netherlands.
- Reddit closed its API to paid products in November 2025.
- Snapchat and Pinterest have delivered nothing since September.

A sample of the latest Benelux signals on 13 November held six Google Trends items as platform evidence; everything else was press. The Chinese hot-search lists deliver hundreds of observed signals a day. Whatever European youth are doing, a European trend could hardly meet the bar.

## What changes

**Two new adapters, free and official, for 8 countries (BE, NL, FR, DE, ES, IT, SE, GB):**
- **`apple-charts`**: the top 25 free iPhone apps and the 25 most played Apple Music songs per country, from the chart feeds Apple publishes (rss.marketingtools.apple.com).
  - Apps go in as platform `app-store`, songs as `apple-music`.
  - The feed is uneven: in two live runs, four of sixteen charts timed out or answered 502. Each chart is asked up to three times, and a chart still missing is read the next day.
- **`shazam-charts`**: the Shazam top 50 per country, from the CSV Shazam publishes with each chart.
  - The country charts really differ: on 13 November the top 50s of Belgium and the Netherlands shared 21 songs, the Netherlands and the UK 15.
  - Shazam's CSV has no link per song, so the identity is the country, artist and title, the rule google-trends learned.
- In both, an entry is a signal the first time it is on a country's chart. Staying on the chart is not news. The same song on two countries' charts is two sightings. Every round records the rank as a snapshot, so a climb can be read later.
- Each signal carries `country` in its meta, so the trend origin counts it for that country.
- **They enter on trial.** The collector seeds `src-apple-charts` and `src-shazam-charts` in state `trial`: read and classified from the first round, off the record until a person admits them (Standard, rules.source.entry).
- `regionToLang` also knows Spain, Italy and Sweden; they read as English until now.

**`bin/apify-trial.mjs`, to choose paid actors by running them:**
- Seven candidates, each with a ceiling (`maxTotalChargeUsd`), $1.35 together at most:
  - Pinterest growing searches, two actors on Belgium;
  - TikTok sounds from the Explore feed for Belgium and the Netherlands (the one road to TikTok there), and rising sounds from the chart for France and Germany;
  - the newest Vinted listings in Belgium, two actors;
  - Google Play top free and trending for Belgium and the Netherlands.
- Where two actors cover one platform, they get the same country, so they can be held side by side. That is how the TikTok actor was chosen on 20 September, when a third actor gave German hashtags for Belgium.
- Without `--run` it only names them. Nothing is written to the store, and seller and user fields are never printed.

## Live check from the workbench (13 November)

- shazam-charts: 400 signals over 8 countries, no errors.
- apple-charts: 300 of 400 on the first two runs, four charts failing each time (different ones). Since then, three attempts per chart.

The first round after deploy brings each chart in whole, about 700 to 800 signals once. After that, only what is new on a chart.

## After the merge, on the box

1. Nothing to do for the charts. The next collect seeds both rows on trial and reads them.
2. The paid trial, once (at most $1.35):
   ```
   node bin/apify-trial.mjs --run
   ```
   Its output decides which actors get an adapter.
3. After the 14-day trial, when the scorecard says ready, a person admits them with the terms:
   ```
   node bin/source-scorecard.mjs
   node bin/source-state.mjs admit src-shazam-charts --terms=<allowed|attribution> --by=<name>
   node bin/source-state.mjs admit src-apple-charts --terms=<allowed|attribution> --by=<name>
   ```

## Tests

- New: `test/european-charts.test.mjs` (11 tests):
  - Shazam's CSV with its date line, byte-order mark and commas inside quotes;
  - a song in two countries is two sightings, the same song twice is one;
  - a signal the first time on a chart, the rank kept every round, an empty chart is an error;
  - Apple apps and songs on their own platforms, and the retry;
  - both declared fully and in the register;
  - the trial's ceilings, its pairs, and that it never prints a seller or a user.
- Full suite 1687/1687, tsc clean.
params.title: European charts from Apple and Shazam, and a capped trial for paid actors
